decisions.reason: As the flagship citrus crate, its option value remains high and keeping it open costs little.
The stackable crate is a low-differentiation commodity line whose option value has likely expired.
The medium-duty rackable pallet has little strategic focus and no longer justifies keeping the option open.
Environmental-compliance demand may still emerge, so the spill-retention pallet remains a valuable option.
The differentiated load-retention feature still holds option value and is cheap to maintain.
